development.scientific_role: post-hoc development semantic repair; not independent confirmation

economic_hypothesis: Price and volume can confirm that ordinary supply was absorbed, but an unresolved issuer-level solvency or integrity shock can create a discontinuous left tail. The guard may veto only an official title that itself states an issuer-level adverse fact. A governance document that merely discusses a risk topic is not the adverse fact.

knowledge_time.sse: max(original ADDDATE, SSEDATE + 1 calendar day 00:00 Asia/Shanghai)
knowledge_time.szse: source-second publishTime when present; otherwise publishTime date + 1 calendar day 00:00 Asia/Shanghai

later_period_protocol.2022_2024: Open exactly once only after the corrected 2018-2021 replay passes this frozen success contract. The parent V28R2 summary is already known, but V29R2 titles, selected identities and exact outcome replay remain unopened.
later_period_protocol.2025_plus: Post-selection diagnostic only. Known 2025-2026 V27 behavior motivated the issuer-risk hypothesis and cannot be pristine validation evidence.

semantic_rule.close_treatment: An explicit CLOSE never shortens the 120-calendar-day cooling period.
semantic_rule.document_role_gate: Independent-director opinions, routine special audit/review/explanation reports, related-fund-flow tables, lawyer/accountant/valuer/broker verification attachments, and inquiry replies cannot create or reset OPEN unless the title itself contains a new explicit adverse fact.

families.CONTROLLER_FUND_MISAPPROPRIATION: OPEN only for illegal transfer or an explicit fund-occupation event/state predicate such as occurrence, existence, non-operating occupation, unreturned funds, remediation or progress; generic topic/review titles are IGNORE.
families.ILLEGAL_GUARANTEE: OPEN only for a non-derived event notice explicitly stating illegal guarantee or guarantee without required approval; an official notice that the issuer received an exchange inquiry is a new OPEN, while replies and verification attachments are IGNORE.
families.ISSUER_BANK_ACCOUNT_FREEZE: Unchanged V1 issuer or subsidiary bank-account freeze fact rule.
families.REGULATORY_INVESTIGATION: OPEN only for a securities regulator investigation of the issuer or an explicit issuer investigation progress/risk notice; police cases and titles explicitly naming a shareholder, controller, director or executive as the subject are IGNORE.
families.RISK_WARNING_OR_DELISTING: Unchanged V1 risk-warning or delisting-risk fact rule.

semantic_rule.rule: Admit only when zero qualifying OPEN issuer-fact titles fall inside the inclusive prior 120-calendar-day window.
semantic_rule.threshold_search: NONE; 120 calendar days is carried unchanged from V29R1 so this experiment isolates the semantic repair.

stage_b_constant_contract.entry: first legal buyable one-minute open strictly after the completed signal
